These procedures are continually being refined and any consequence of a variation between the predicted and the actual is minor compared with the consequences of not planning at all. Surveys indicate that 2/3 of those people going to General Mitchell Field will use the Airport Spur.
Airport Spur will allow for more and faster movement of cargo and therefore, will benefit industry, business and trucking.
The movement of cargo, however, is not the primary benefit derived from the Airport Spur. It will also allow for safer and more efficient movement of passengers by both auto and rubber tired mass transit vehicles.
Traffic projections for 1990 indicate 19,600 vehicles using the Airport Spur. Nine percent would be truck traffic.
